name: Key ASIC Berhad
overview: 今年公司签订绿色AI数据中心战略合作备忘录，拟在马来西亚联合开发建设大型绿色AI数据中心；同时进行多轮集资活动。最新一季营收同比下滑36.5%，但净利润转正。
overview_en: This year the company entered into a Green AI Data Centre strategic cooperation MOU for the proposed joint development and construction of a large-scale Green AI Data Centre in Malaysia, and carried out multiple fund-raising exercises. Latest quarterly revenue fell 36.5% year-on-year, while net profit turned positive.
